faq.q: What templates are available and how are they generated?
faq.a: Four live-preview templates: Classic (single column), Modern (two-column sidebar with photo and skill bars), Minimal (clean) and ATS-Safe (plain). You pick an accent colour and the tool even warns if it's too pale to read on white (checking contrast against a 4.5:1 ratio). The PDF is generated directly with pdf-lib, so sections, fonts and spacing are laid out precisely rather than screenshotting the preview.

faq.q: Does it check how ATS-friendly my resume is?
faq.a: Yes. A live ATS score out of 100 awards points for name, email, phone, location, a substantial summary, 5+ skills, filled experience and education, use of action verbs (managed, developed, led...), and quantified achievements like "increased sales by 20%". It lists specific fixes, and selecting the ATS-Safe template adds points for maximum parser compatibility.

faq.q: Can I add a photo without bloating the PDF?
faq.a: Yes. Upload or drag a profile photo and choose a quality preset — Compact (max 240px), Balanced (400px) or High (640px) — each re-encodes the image as JPEG at a different size so the PDF doesn't balloon. The photo appears on templates that use it. Non-Latin text (rupee sign, Hindi, emoji) triggers a Unicode font so the PDF still generates.

Download a styled PDF, a plain-text .txt built field-by-field for pasting into ATS forms, or a ZIP bundling the PDF, the TXT, a JSON of your data for later re-import, and a README. You can also copy as plain text or print. Everything you enter autosaves locally under resumeBuilderData and runs entirely in your browser.
